content: Choose Upload files or Upload folder from New, or drag and drop files into the file list.

comment.text: Body of the Files onboarding tour step that highlights the opened New menu. Upload files, Upload folder and New are UI labels of menu items and the button and should match their translations.

usage.context:
canOpenNewMenu &&
 menuStep(
 NEW_BUTTON_TRIGGER_SELECTOR,
 NEW_MENU_SELECTOR,
 t("FilesTour:TourBringFilesTitle"),
 t("FilesTour:TourBringFiles"),
 callbacks,
 FILES_TOUR_LABEL,
 [NEW_BUTTON_SELECTOR], // spotlight the button together with the menu
 ),
